item.text: The failure is caused by CSS: `.project-row { display: flex }` overrides the browser’s default styling for the `hidden` attribute, so archived rows remain visibly rendered after filtering. I’ll add an explicit hidden-state rule and run the app against the archive lifecycle and persistence behavior.
